title: Kestrel GAP Waiver Eligibility Guideline
content:
# Kestrel GAP Waiver Eligibility Guideline

## Eligibility rule

A Kestrel GAP Waiver is sold only when all four of the following hold for the level being sold:

1. the amount financed is within the waiver's maximum amount financed;
2. the finance term is within the waiver's maximum term;
3. the vehicle's model age is within the waiver's maximum model age;
4. the loan-to-value at sale — the amount financed divided by the vehicle cash price — is within the waiver's entry limit.

Coverage starts on the finance contract date and runs to the original maturity date.

"Within" a limit means not above it: a figure equal to the limit qualifies.

## Limits applied, by level

| Level | Maximum amount financed (USD) | Maximum term | Maximum model age | Loan-to-value entry limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel GAP Essential | 50000.00 | 72 months | 10 years | 115 percent |
| Kestrel GAP Standard | 60000.00 | 72 months | 10 years | 125 percent |
| Kestrel GAP Plus | 75000.00 | 75 months | 8 years | 125 percent |
| Kestrel GAP Premier | 85000.00 | 75 months | 8 years | 150 percent |
| Kestrel GAP Premier Plus | 100000.00 | 75 months | 7 years | 150 percent |
| Kestrel GAP Max | 125000.00 | 75 months | 7 years | 175 percent |

## All four tests together

The four tests are joined by "and": one test failed is enough for the level not to be sold.

| Amount financed within limit | Term within limit | Model age within limit | Loan-to-value within limit | Level can be sold |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| No | any | any | any | No |
| any | No | any | any | No |
| any | any | No | any | No |
| any | any | any | No | No |

## Test cases (hypothetical loans)

- **Kestrel GAP Standard, on the limit.** Cash price 24000.00, amount financed 30000.00, term 72 months, model age 10 years. Loan-to-value is 30000.00 divided by 24000.00, which is 125 percent, equal to the entry limit; amount financed, term and age are within their limits. Eligible.
- **Kestrel GAP Standard, just over.** Same loan with an amount financed of 30024.00: loan-to-value is 125.1 percent, above 125 percent. Not eligible at Standard.
- **Kestrel GAP Plus, term.** A 75-month term is within Plus (75 months) but above Essential and Standard (72 months).
- **Kestrel GAP Premier Plus, model age.** A vehicle 8 model years old is above the 7-year limit of Premier Plus and Max, and within the 8-year limit of Plus and Premier.

## Coverage period

For a waiver that is sold, coverage begins on the finance contract date and runs to the original maturity date of that contract.
